hypothesis: Porting the ix-quality-trend pattern (nightly structured health artifact) to Demerzel as a per-artifact effectiveness-delta stream will surface stagnation before it accumulates into the kind of 27-day staleness that produced Discussion #242. Continuous measurement is cheaper than periodic compound runs and complements rather than replaces them.

plan.description: Create skill .claude/skills/demerzel-quality-trend/SKILL.md that, on each invocation, computes per-artifact deltas (citation_count, compliance_rate, last_cited age) since the previous run and appends a JSONL line to state/quality-trend/YYYY-MM.jsonl. Keep it small — no new schema, just JSONL with {timestamp, artifact, delta_citations, delta_compliance, age_days}. Optionally wire to Friday cron alongside harvest+compound.
plan.success_criteria: After 2 weeks of nightly runs, the trend file shows distinguishable trajectories — at least one artifact identified as accelerating and at least one as stagnating that compound runs alone hadn't flagged.
risks: JSONL files growing unbounded — auto-rotate monthly
Noise vs signal — initial 2 weeks may be too short to distinguish trend from variance; commit to 4 weeks before deciding
Duplicating compound's job — keep this skill *measurement only*; do not let it propose changes (compound owns proposals)
